EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Key
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Create a System-generated, Read-Only API key in Bybit Dashboard → API → Create New Key. Enable permissions: "Bybit Card" (transaction history), "Earn → Earn" (redeemable Flexible Earn balance), "Wallet → Account Transfer / Subaccount Transfer" (Funding balance), and "Exchange → Exchange History" (Funding coin valuation). Do NOT enable trading or withdrawal permissions. Paste the API Key here.

EditTextPreference.title: Read-only API Secret
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Paste the API Secret that was shown once when you created the API key. The secret is used to sign requests with HMAC-SHA256 and is never sent to Bybit in plain text.

ListPreference.title: Bybit account region
ListPreference.dialogMessage: Choose the Bybit site where this account was registered. The plugin uses only official API hosts; no URL needs to be entered manually.

EditTextPreference.title: From what date to load transactions
EditTextPreference.dialogTitle: From what date to load transactions

CheckBoxPreference.title: Sync wallet transfers
CheckBoxPreference.dialogMessage: Import confirmed external deposits and withdrawals, Funding ↔ Unified transfers, and Flexible Earn subscriptions/redemptions. Failed, pending and ambiguous records are ignored.

EditTextPreference.title: Transfer assets
EditTextPreference.dialogMessage: Comma-separated stable-value assets to import as nominal USD wallet movements: USDT, USDC, FDUSD, TUSD and USD. Other coins remain included in account balances and valuation without creating misleading historical USD cash flow.

ListPreference.title: External deposit wallet
ListPreference.dialogMessage: Choose the deposit account configured in Bybit. The history API does not expose which wallet received an older external deposit, so the plugin never guesses.

ListPreference.title: Flexible Earn source wallet
ListPreference.dialogMessage: Choose the wallet you normally use for Flexible Earn subscriptions and redemptions. Bybit's Earn order history omits the historical source account.

CheckBoxPreference.title: Sync Bybit Card
CheckBoxPreference.dialogMessage: Enable only if you use a Bybit Card and granted its read-only permission. When off, the plugin shows Unified, Funding and Flexible Earn without creating a Card account or importing card purchases.

ListPreference.title: Bybit Card payment source
ListPreference.dialogMessage: Choose the source selected in Bybit Card payment settings. The Bybit API does not provide this setting, so the plugin never guesses. Choose Flexible Earn only when Auto-Deduction is enabled there; otherwise choose Funding.
